title: Stardust usage event
description: A raw usage event as captured by a client layer (chat plugin, browser extension, infra agent) and sent to Stardust Core for enrichment. Spec §7. Field names mirror OTel GenAI conventions where one exists (§11.1). Unknown fields are rejected.

event_id.description: RFC 4122 UUID. Generated by Core if omitted.

provider.description: Provider slug, e.g. anthropic, openai, google, aws, azure, gcp, self-hosted. OTel: gen_ai.provider.name.

model.description: Model name or infrastructure service identifier. OTel: gen_ai.request.model. Use "unknown" when the client cannot see it.

region.description: Processing region where known (e.g. us-east-1). OTel: cloud.region.

timestamp.description: When the operation happened. Include the client's UTC offset; Core stores UTC.

tokens_cached_in.description: Input tokens served from the provider's prompt cache. Included in tokens_in, and priced at the cache-read rate.

tokens_estimated.description: True when token counts were approximated (e.g. from message length) rather than read from a provider usage payload.

energy_reuse_factor.description: The facility's Energy Reuse Factor (ISO/IEC 30134-6), when its operator reports it. Core then reports heat_recovered_wh. OTel: stardust.facility.energy_reuse_factor.

otel_trace_id.description: W3C/OpenTelemetry trace id (lowercase hex) of the span that made the AI call, when the caller uses OpenTelemetry. Core exports its stardust.impact span into this trace (§11.3).

otel_span_id.description: Span id of that span; parent of Core's stardust.impact span.
